title: truncate() can return a string longer than the requested length
body:
`truncate("hello world", 1)` returns `"..."`, which is 3 characters even though I asked for 1. Looks like the suffix isn't accounted for when `length` is smaller than the suffix itself.

Expected: the result should never be longer than `length`.

comments.author: maintainer
comments.body: Confirmed, good catch. Please add a regression test alongside the fix.
